title: asplenium cuspidatum var. parvulum
intro: Asplenium cuspidatum var. parvulum, commonly known as Taiwan spleenwort, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Aspleniaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Taiwan spleenwort include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its expectorant and diuretic effects, which may help to relieve congestion and reduce fluid retention, while its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties.
